optimizedContext.value:
# SQLite Graph Store

## Rules
- `SQLiteGraphStore` implements `GraphStore` using `better-sqlite3`; id `sqlite`; native binding deferred to `open()`; `close()` idempotent.
- One open store = one persistent `node:worker_threads` worker + SQLite connection. Worker owns DB, statements, transactions, schema, FTS, filesystem. Typed structured-clone DTOs/correlation ids only; FIFO serial queue; no native handles/functions/classes cross boundary.
- `maxPendingOperations >= 1`, default 256; excess rejects `StoreOverloadError`. `close()` rejects new work, drains default 5000 ms, asks worker close, force-terminates; unsettled → `StoreWorkerError`. Worker fault rejects outstanding; recovery explicit `close()` + `open()`, never restart.
- Runtime crosses via serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`; absolute `modulePath` → `file:` URL; package/already-qualified URLs unchanged. Worker test override not public. Sessions use `sessionId`, lifecycle generation, explicit active/committing/rolling-back/finished states. Progress callback failures isolated.
- Batch nodes/relations execute one RPC, set-based SQL, deterministic bounded parameter chunks; preserve ordering, dedup, unknown/empty behavior. Filtered impact parameterized in SQL; canonical workspace predicates; exclusions win; constrain frontier before hydration; normalized filter preserved host→worker→database.
- Persist `{configPath}/graph`, scratch `{configPath}/tmp`; companion files local. `recreate()` closed-only, rotates storage generation, preserves `index.lock`, retries access-lock deletion errors; known corruption/schema failures map typed recoverable error. `clear()` one atomic logical generation reset; no stale skip authority after commit.
- Persist files (source), documents, symbols/specs/meta, all relation types incl `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`, coverage logical targets. Bulk staged worker session/chunks, atomic commit, progress stages.
- FTS5 symbol/spec/document candidate generation, shared lexical expansion, identity candidates and explicit SQL rank: exact identity > strong identity > content; token coverage helps; snippets/line ranges.
- Schema version 12; incompatible version → `GraphSchemaIncompatibleError`/`SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE`, rebuild derived store/epoch/indexes; no `ALTER TABLE`/mixed v10/v11. Version 12 logical-member columns and equality `qualified_name` index; canonical IDs never parsed for semantic lookup.

## Constraints
- SQLite-specific adapter; storage-neutral consumers use `code-graph:graph-store`.
- Synchronous SQLite never host event loop.
- All artifacts rooted `configPath`; force reindex logical clear, not deletion/reopen.
